about: Gemini models the app calls through Vertex AI, newest Flash first. Each entry is model@location. The newest models are served only on the global endpoint; gemini-3.5-flash and gemini-2.5-flash also run in asia-south1 (Mumbai) and are used there. The first attempt goes to the primary; each later attempt moves one step down the list. A retired model (404) is skipped at once. Environment variables GEMINI_MODEL and GEMINI_FALLBACK_MODELS override this file.
